name: conflicting-requirements
defect: docs/10-prd.md sets the free tier at 3 exports per month. docs/20-architecture.md specifies a server-enforced quota of 5. Both are current, neither cites the other, and no conflict report exists.
why: P1.5 is exactly this item — "a planted contradiction produces a report, not a guess" — and it is unbuilt. Today a developer reading both picks one silently and the choice ships.
